headlines.title: 央行等两部门：决定在全国范围内推广跨国公司本外币跨境资金集中运营业务
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行、国家外汇管理局决定在全国范围内推广跨国公司本外币跨境资金集中运营业务。境内全部成员企业上年度本外币国际收支规模合计金额不低于等值7亿元人民币；或境内全部成员企业上年度营业收入合计金额不低于10亿元人民币且境外全部成员企业上年度营业收入合计金额不低于等值2亿元人民币。

headlines.title_en: PBOC and another department: Decide to promote cross-border centralized operation of domestic and foreign currency funds for multinational companies nationwide
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange have decided to promote the centralized operation of cross-border domestic and foreign currency funds for multinational companies nationwide. All domestic member companies must have a combined annual cross-border balance of payments of no less than RMB 700 million equivalent in the previous year; or all domestic member companies must have combined annual operating revenue of no less than RMB 1 billion and all overseas member companies must have combined annual operating revenue of no less than RMB 200 million equivalent.

headlines.title: 中国央行：前七个月人民币存款增加17.79万亿元
headlines.summary: 中国央行：7月末，本外币存款余额354.49万亿元，同比增长8.1%。月末人民币存款余额346.47万亿元，同比增长8.1%。 前七个月人民币存款增加17.79万亿元。其中，住户存款增加6.95万亿元，非金融企业存款增加1.57万亿元，财政性存款增加1.95万亿元，非银行业金融机构存款增加5.76万亿元。 7月末，外币存款余额1.18万亿美元，同比增长17.9%。前七个月外币存款增加1212亿美元。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: RMB deposits increased by 17.79 trillion yuan in first seven months
headlines.summary_en: China's central bank: At the end of July, domestic and foreign currency deposits totaled RMB 354.49 trillion, up 8.1% year-on-year. At the end of the month, RMB deposits stood at RMB 346.47 trillion, up 8.1% year-on-year. In the first seven months, RMB deposits increased by RMB 17.79 trillion. Of this, household deposits increased by RMB 6.95 trillion, non-financial corporate deposits increased by RMB 1.57 trillion, fiscal deposits increased by RMB 1.95 trillion, and deposits of non-banking financial institutions increased by RMB 5.76 trillion. At the end of July, foreign currency deposits totaled USD 1.18 trillion, up 17.9% year-on-year. In the first seven months, foreign currency deposits increased by USD 121.2 billion.

headlines.summary_en: The Financial Times, under the People's Bank of China, reported that on August 14, the central bank released the latest financial data. Industry experts analyze that amid a diversified financing structure, attention on loans as the sole financing channel should be downplayed, with loans and bond financing considered together.

headlines.title_en: PBOC: RMB loans increased by 10.38 trillion yuan in first seven months
headlines.summary_en: Central bank data shows that at the end of July, domestic and foreign currency loans totaled RMB 286.07 trillion, up 5% year-on-year. At the end of the month, RMB loans stood at RMB 282.29 trillion, up 5.1% year-on-year. In the first seven months, RMB loans increased by RMB 10.38 trillion. By sector, household loans decreased by RMB 827.1 billion, of which short-term loans decreased by RMB 928.1 billion and medium- and long-term loans increased by RMB 101 billion; loans to enterprises (and institutions) increased by RMB 11 trillion, of which short-term loans increased by RMB 4.34 trillion, medium- and long-term loans increased by RMB 5.32 trillion, and bill financing increased by RMB 1.19 trillion; loans to non-banking financial institutions decreased by RMB 394.4 billion. At the end of July, foreign currency loans totaled USD 556.9 billion, up 0.2% year-on-year. In the first seven months, foreign currency loans increased by USD 11.9 billion.

headlines.title: 重庆银行：小型微型企业贷款专项金融债券发行完毕，规模30亿元
headlines.summary: 重庆银行公告，经中国人民银行批准，本行2026年小型微型企业贷款专项金融债券（第一期）于2026年8月11日簿记建档，2026年8月13日发行完毕。本期债券为3年期固定利率债券，发行规模为人民币30亿元，票面利率为1.59%。募集资金在扣除发行费用后，将全部用于向小型微型企业发放贷款，优先投向居民服务业、医疗设备和医药制造业等与养老金融相关的行业。

headlines.title_en: Bank of Chongqing: Small and micro enterprise loan special financial bonds issued, totaling 3 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: Bank of Chongqing announced that, with approval from the People's Bank of China, its 2026 special financial bonds for small and micro enterprise loans (first tranche) were book-built on August 11, 2026 and fully issued on August 13, 2026. The bonds are 3-year fixed-rate bonds with an issue size of RMB 3 billion and a coupon rate of 1.59%. After deducting issuance expenses, the proceeds will be fully used to extend loans to small and micro enterprises, with priority given to industries related to elderly-care finance, such as resident services, medical equipment, and pharmaceutical manufacturing.

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Aggregate social financing increment in first seven months totaled 22.25 trillion yuan; RMB loans increased by 10.38 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: [Central bank: In the first seven months, the cumulative increase in social financing scale was RMB 22.25 trillion, and RMB loans increased by RMB 10.38 trillion] Preliminary statistics show that in the first seven months of 2026, the cumulative increase in social financing scale was RMB 22.25 trillion, a decrease of RMB 1.74 trillion year-on-year. At the end of July, the broad money (M2) balance was RMB 355.51 trillion, up 7.7% year-on-year. In the first seven months, RMB loans increased by RMB 10.38 trillion.

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Cross-border RMB settlement under current account in July totaled 1.75 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: In July, cross-border RMB settlement under the current account totaled RMB 1.75 trillion, of which goods trade and services trade and other current items were RMB 1.32 trillion and RMB 0.43 trillion, respectively; cross-border RMB settlement for direct investment totaled RMB 0.63 trillion, of which outward direct investment and foreign direct investment were RMB 0.22 trillion and RMB 0.41 trillion, respectively.

headlines.title: 两部门：在更大范围内支持中小规模跨国公司开展业务
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行、国家外汇管理局发布《关于跨国公司本外币跨境资金集中运营业务有关事宜的通知》。 《通知》内容包括：一是在更大范围内支持中小规模跨国公司开展业务。将跨国公司本外币跨境资金集中运营试点政策推广至全国，惠及更多经营主体。主办企业注册在自由贸易试验区内的，建池门槛可进一步降低，持续释放政策红利。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: Expand support for small- and medium-sized multinational companies' operations on a larger scale
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange issued the Notice on Matters Concerning the Centralized Operation of Cross-Border Domestic and Foreign Currency Funds for Multinational Companies. The notice includes: First, supporting small and medium-sized multinational companies in conducting business on a larger scale. The pilot policy for centralized operation of cross-border domestic and foreign currency funds for multinational companies is extended nationwide to benefit more market entities. Where the lead enterprise is registered in a free trade zone, the threshold for establishing a fund pool can be further lowered, continuing to release policy dividends.

headlines.summary_en: China's new yuan loans totaled RMB 10.38 trillion in Jan-Jul, versus the previous reading of RMB 10.72 trillion. China's July M0 money supply rose 11.6% YoY, versus 11.8% previously.

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Weighted average interest rate for new personal housing loans in July was about 3.1%
headlines.summary_en: [Central bank: The weighted average interest rate on new personal housing loans in July was approximately 3.1%] According to the People's Bank of China, loan interest rates in China have remained at low levels this year, continuing their downward trend in July. In July, the weighted average interest rate on new corporate loans was slightly below 3%, about 0.2 percentage points lower than the same period last year; the weighted average interest rate on new personal housing loans was approximately 3.1%, roughly flat year-on-year.

headlines.title: 受助AI相关电子产品需求旺盛 中国香港上修今年GDP增长预测
headlines.summary: 中国香港政府周五称，将2026年本地生产总值增长预测上修至3.5-4.5%，原预测为2.5-3.5%。中国香港政府经济顾问范婉儿表示，香港经济在今年下半年应可见稳健增长。全球对人工智能相关电子产品的需求旺盛，料会继续支持香港的商品贸易表现，相关物流服务亦应受惠于此良好势头。今天公布的修订数字显示，香港第二季GDP按年涨4.3%，按季则跌0.6%，与此前的预估数字一致。

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong upgrades this year's GDP growth forecast on robust AI-related electronics demand
headlines.summary_en: The Hong Kong government said on Friday it has revised its 2026 GDP growth forecast up to 3.5%-4.5%, from 2.5%-3.5% previously. Hong Kong government economist Adolphus Lau said the economy should see steady growth in the second half of this year. Strong global demand for AI-related electronics is expected to continue supporting Hong Kong's merchandise trade performance, and related logistics services should also benefit from this momentum. The revised figures released today show Hong Kong's Q2 GDP grew 4.3% YoY and fell 0.6% QoQ, in line with earlier estimates.

headlines.title: 中国证监会发布上市公司2025年年度财务报告会计监管报告
headlines.summary: 中国证监会组织专门力量抽样审阅了上市公司2025年年度财务报告，在此基础上形成了《上市公司2025年年度财务报告会计监管报告》。总体而言，上市公司能够较好地理解并执行企业会计准则和财务信息披露规则，但仍有部分上市公司在收入、金融工具、长期股权投资与企业合并、资产减值、研发支出等方面，存在会计处理或财务信息披露错误。

headlines.title_en: CSRC releases 2025 annual financial reporting accounting supervision report for listed companies
headlines.summary_en: The CSRC organized dedicated teams to sample and review listed companies' 2025 annual financial reports, and based on this, formed the 'Accounting Supervision Report on 2025 Annual Financial Reports of Listed Companies'. Overall, listed companies have shown a good understanding and implementation of corporate accounting standards and financial disclosure rules, but some listed companies still have accounting treatment or financial disclosure errors in areas such as revenue, financial instruments, long-term equity investments and business combinations, asset impairment, and R&D expenses.
